lessons.objective: Learner can understand, explain and apply geometric tools.
teaching_sequence: Begin with a concrete or familiar situation.
Name the mathematical idea and connect it to prior knowledge.
Model a complete worked example with every step explained.
Move from representation to symbols and then to a new problem.
Ask the learner to explain the method without copying.
lessons.checkpoint: Explain geometric tools without notes and solve a new example.

items.question: Which approach best helps you understand geometric tools?
options: Identify what is known, represent it clearly, choose a valid method, and check the result.
Choose an operation before reading the problem.
Copy a worked answer.
Guess and stop.
items.explanation: Understanding the situation, choosing a method and checking the result makes mathematical reasoning reliable.

items.question: Explain geometric tools as if you were teaching it to someone learning from the basics.
items.answer: A correct response defines geometric tools, gives a simple example, and explains the reasoning.

items.question: Create and solve a new everyday problem involving geometric tools.
items.expected_response: A valid problem, correct solution and explanation of the method.

options: Use major ideas independently in a new situation and explain the reasoning.

flashcards.back: Define geometric tools, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define constructing shapes, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define circles and arcs, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define accuracy and reasoning, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore geometric tools
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on geometric tools. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where constructing shapes is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach accuracy and reasoning to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
